summary: Completed frontend testing of Auditions page autoplay with sound feature. All implementation is correct. Videos attempt autoplay with sound after user interaction. The autoplay logic correctly handles browser restrictions by falling back to muted playback. Some test videos have broken S3 URLs (pre-existing data issue, not related to autoplay implementation).

issues: Some videos show 'The element has no supported sources' error - this is a pre-existing S3 URL data issue, NOT related to autoplay implementation

passed_tests: Auditions page loads without critical JavaScript errors
Audition container renders correctly with video elements
Videos attempt autoplay when page loads (console shows 'Autoplay with sound prevented, trying muted...')
Autoplay fallback to muted works correctly when browser blocks unmuted autoplay
userInteracted state is properly initialized as false
userInteracted state is set to true after click/touchstart/keydown events
userInteracted prop is correctly passed through AuditionsPage -> AuditionItem -> VideoDisplay
isMuted state defaults to false (sound enabled by default)
Mute button shows Volume2 icon (unmuted) by default - CORRECT
Mute button toggles to VolumeX icon (muted) when clicked
Mute button toggles back to Volume2 icon (unmuted) when clicked again
Scrolling to different videos triggers autoplay attempt for new video
Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown) scrolls to next video
critical_code_review_comments: Autoplay implementation is correct: tries unmuted first, falls back to muted (lines 224-248)
userInteracted state tracking is properly implemented with event listeners (lines 884-901)
isMuted defaults to false (line 868) - sound enabled by default as requested
Props are correctly passed through component hierarchy: AuditionsPage -> AuditionItem -> VideoDisplay
The playback useEffect correctly uses userInteracted to decide initial muted state (line 229)
After user interaction, if isMuted is false, video is unmuted after play starts (lines 234-236)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autoplay with sound feature is fully implemented and working correctly. Key implementation details: 1) userInteracted state tracks if user has clicked/touched/pressed key, 2) isMuted defaults to false (sound enabled), 3) Playback useEffect tries unmuted first if userInteracted is true, falls back to muted if browser blocks. Note: Some videos have broken S3 URLs causing 'no supported sources' errors - this is a pre-existing data issue, not related to autoplay implementation. The autoplay logic correctly handles this by catching errors and falling back gracefully.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - No issues found with the autoplay implementation. The 'element has no supported sources' errors are caused by broken S3 video URLs in the database, which is a pre-existing data issue mentioned in the agent context.
